# Design point P013

## Description

As stated, the combination is not a fully accepted design: per-server authoritative repository placement tracking is rejected, while writes use per-write voting without a primary and clients use partial clone acquisition. The accepted write and acquisition choices could coexist, but the rejected routing approach would need replacement before the system could provide a consistent solution.
